title: fix: narrow antiforgery exemptions + add regression tests
description: Remove blanket [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] from controllers except validated API-key/OAuth callback endpoints. Add integration tests that POST to admin/source endpoints without antiforgery token => 400 and a CI invariant asserting the exempt-controller list.

comments.body: Implemented and validated 2026-07-26. Removed controller-level IgnoreAntiforgeryToken from MemorySmith.App/Controllers/AdminController.cs and SourceLinksController.cs. Added MemorySmith.Tests/AntiforgeryTestHelpers.cs, converted bootstrap/admin settings callers, and added AdminSetup_RejectsJsonPostWithoutAntiforgeryToken. Focused command covering SecurityAndSourceLinkTests, AppApiContractTests, SqliteMetadataStoreTests, and SemanticEmbeddingPathTests: 77 passed, 0 failed. Residual controller exemptions are documented in Data/Pages/Handoffs/2026-07-26-wave-1-antiforgery-paths.md and require separate endpoint-contract review.
